bio: Green tea, Monstera cuttings, and quiet gardens. Talk plants to me.

nodes.partnerMessage: Hello {PlayerName} 🌱! Just finished repotting my rare carnivorous plants. Do you keep any greenery in your space?

choices.choiceText: I have succulents on my desk.
I usually forget to water plastic plants.

nodes.partnerMessage: Good light and draining soil! You have natural instincts. My botanical collection is too vast for this UI.
Oh no! We need to rehabilitate your botanical karma immediately. I brew relaxing herbal infusions.
